findings.problem: The English is passive: the choice is made for the reader when the conversation starts. 即可设置 states a permission ('you can then set it'), which moves the agent from the system to the reader and is the only one of the seven locales that is not passive (es Se establece, fr Défini, ru Задаётся, vi Sẽ được thiết lập, hi तय होगा, ur طے ہو جائے گا). The en sidecar for this key says the line 'must not read as an instruction'. Not escalated to MAJOR: the sentence is idiomatic, true of the product once the conversation exists, and asks nothing of the reader.
findings.checked: no placeholders; 20 cells vs EN 33; no maxCells hint on this key.

findings.current: 上下文：暂无读数。随着对话进行，上下文窗口会逐渐填充。
findings.current_also: 暂无读数。随着对话进行，上下文窗口会逐渐填充。
findings.source: Context: nothing measured yet. The window fills as the conversation runs.
findings.problem: 'Nothing measured yet' is a fact about measurement; 暂无读数 is 'no reading yet', the wording the en sidecar records as deliberately rejected because it is equally true of a resumed session. The distinction the English draws (nothing has been measured yet, versus a value that will arrive by itself) is lost and the following sentence has to carry it alone. Both keys use the same opening, so they are consistent with each other and inconsistent with the source.
findings.suggested: 上下文：尚未测量。随着对话进行，上下文窗口会逐渐填充。
findings.suggested_also: 尚未测量。随着对话进行，上下文窗口会逐渐填充。
findings.checked: no placeholders; 54/46 cells vs EN 73/64; no maxCells hint.

findings.current: 跳转到你的消息（第{turn, number}轮，共{total, number}轮），{clock}
findings.current_also: 跳转到你的消息（第{turn, number}轮，共{total, number}轮）
findings.problem: The two user ticks spell the progress pair （第N轮，共M轮） while jump_agent, jump_agent_unnamed and checkpoint.turn spell it （共M轮）. Both forms are idiomatic; three of five agreeing is what makes the fifth visible to a screen-reader user walking the rail. Carried unchanged from the wave A receipt (wavea-zh-d1), which recorded it as a declination rather than a defect; this pass independently agrees and records it so it is not lost.
